theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+1.97%) and Industrials (+0.97%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-1.12%) and Real Estate (-0.70%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.11% versus -0.34% for defensives and -0.23% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.04% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.46%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.91%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 8.92% to 25.64, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.63% to $4,079.50, crude oil was little changed at $90.34, and bitcoin gained 0.06% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
